## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes: Biome, `tsc`, markdownlint, and the tests with coverage
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `ci:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] The Jev question, options or state didn't change, or `npm run eval` was re-run and its summary is below
- [ ] `README.md`, `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, router logs or eval results are committed
